text: Trueheart was the horse Prince Arthas would ride until his true steed, Invincible was able to bear him.

The Tumultuous Cloak can be found inside Satchel of Helpful Goods (level 25).
Tunnel Worm Vest is a quest reward from Trouble in the Mines.
True Beacon Shoulderplates are a quest reward from Welcome News.
Tuft of Gnome Hair is a racial PvP token used for the quest Tuft of Gnome Hair (quest) in order to receive a Dented Ashmaul Strongbox.
Truegold is a metal bar that can only be created by alchemists.
__NOTOC__ Tugnar Goremaw is a black drakonid found at Terror Wing Path in the Burning Steppes.

Captain of the Horde flagship Mannoroth's Bones, Tula was personally picked by Thrall to command the ship because of her experience on the sea. She was the captain during the evacuation of Warsong Hold that was overseen by Cairne Bloodhoof. Having resupplied Warsong Hold over a dozen times before she was shocked when the Kvaldir attacked. After escaping them and a storm, she agreed with Garrosh's decision to attack a lone Alliance vessel that was blown from a storm into Horde waters, to take the supplies from the ruined vessel.
Tunic of Celebration is a quest reward from the post-cataclysm version of Lost But Not Forgotten (Durotar).
Tunic of Dark Leather is a quest reward from Grimaxe's Demise.
Tulgar Flamefist is holding the portal to Orgrimmar open at Hellscream's Grasp in Tol Barad Peninsula.

Truun is a level 31 quest giver located at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border of the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. A member of the Warsong Offensive, he reveals that supplies are short and he has been forced to improvise. Following the conclusion of events at the Rampart, Truun will have players ride the nearby kodo, Brutusk, to the Warsong Lumber Camp.

__NOTOC__ Tunawa Stillwind is a tauren quest giver located near Holgom on The High Road in Southern Barrens, near Hunter's Hill. He has been traversing the area all his life and is determined to prevent the Alliance from taking it. His primary purpose is to send players on their way in their journey to the Southern Barrens.

Truk Stonecrusher was a tauren shaman with the Earthen Ring that lived sometime after the era of the War of the Three Hammers. He spoke in defense of Shotoa, when he proposed the idea of commanding the elements, saying if wasn't Shotoa's fault that he hadn't been taught the old ways of the shaman.

Tsul'Kalu (or Tsul'kalu), the Earth Spirit, is a huge white gorilla rare mob wandering west of Lake Nazferiti in Northern Stranglethorn. They are one of three totemic spirits worshipped by the Bloodscalp tribe, whose members carry idols of the Earth Spirit in the form of small ape-shaped statues. The other two Bloodscalp spirits are Mahamba (water) and Pogeyan (fire). __NOTOC__
Tsul'kalu's Strikers is a quest reward from Sacred to the Bloodscalp.
Tunnel Vision is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Halazzi in Zul'Aman on Heroic difficulty without killing any of his totems.
__NOTOC__ Tunneling Worms are gyreworms found in Kaja'mine of Kezan. When the trolls rebelled, the worms were killed.
Tuffi is a yak located in Pranksters' Hollow in Kun-Lai Summit.

Tsulong is the second boss in the Terrace of Endless Spring. The fight alternates between a more straightforward boss encounter during the Night, and a Valithria-type healing encounter and add fight during the Day. Tsulong himself appears as a large, onyx Cloud Serpent during the night phase, and a golden Cloud Serpent during the daytime phase.

Tu Shen Burial Ground can be found in south-central Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Mistfall Village is below to the southwest, and Whitepetal Lake can be found to the north. It also contains the Tu Shen Digsite, a Mogu digsite. Zandalari trolls targeted the grounds for resurrecting mogu warlords. During the invasion of the Black Empire, N'Zoth's forces tormented ancient pandaren spirits here.
Tulk is a farmer who alongside his sons had to defend himself before attacking thunder lizards.
Tsu the Wanderer is a pandaren located in the Darkspear Training Grounds of the Darkspear Isle in Durotar. He can be seen sparing with Zabrax, the local monk trainer.
The Trove of the Watchers is a trove protected by The Sentinel and The Warden. It contians the Eye of the Watchers.
Tulvan Manservants are human and night elf servants located at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands. They serve Lord Geoffery Tulvan.

The Trove of the Thunder King is found various locations on the Isle of Thunder. It acts much like an Ancient Guo-Lai Cache, but does not require a key. Interacting with a Trove of the Thunder King is the requirement of the Pandaria quest achievement Thunder Plunder. You may only loot one trove per week.

Troves of the Thunder King is a one-player scenario that can only be queued for by offering Taoshi in the Bleak Hollow on the Isle of Thunder one Key to the Palace of Lei Shen. It takes place in the Thunder King's Citadel version of the Throne of Thunder raid instance. There is also a one-time quest, Treasures of the Thunder King (quest), that will award reputation with the Shado-Pan Assault for completing this scenario.
A Trumarf is a race of three combined races, the Humans, Trolls & Dwarves. During the Cataclysm Beta, a bug caused the player's troll to shrink to the size of a dwarf and got human animation.
Tseh Rah, Peacebloom Teamaster is a pandaren monk trainer located at the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.
The Tuft of Yak Fur has a 100% chance to drop from Pengsong in Dread Wastes, and can drop randomly from any yak mob on Timeless Isle.
Tuff Gorehoof is a tauren located at the Circle of Wills in Underbelly.
Tsavo'ka's Den is the westernmost of the three caves in the Red Stone Run. Kukuru's Grotto is immediately to the east, and the Mysterious Den is further east.
Tsavo'ka is a tiger located in Tsavo'ka's Den on the Timeless Isle.
Tunadil the Redeemer was a dwarf paladin who participated in the battle with the dread wyrm, Kaldrigos. He died when he fell on his own sword.

Tura'aka is located just east of Yrel's Watch, and is found next to three dead Alliance Peacekeepers and Morrah, the late Warsong Rylak Master. When first killed, Tura'akawill drop Tura'aka's Clipped Wing along with 20-30 Garrison Resources.
Tumbler Feng is a pandaren located at the Tavern in the Mists in The Veiled Stair.
Tsunami Chestguards are crafted with Leatherworking (490); taught by trainers.
Tsunami Shoulders are crafted with Leatherworking (455); taught by trainers.

True Love Prism is a reward for obtaining the They Really Love Me! achievement during Love is in the Air.

True Iron Ore is gathered from mining True Iron Deposits and Rich True Iron Deposits on . This ore is used by many professions to craft Warlords of Draenor recipes. It can also be created by combining 10 True Iron Nuggets.
Truesteel Ingots are crafted with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Draenor Blacksmithing (item). It is also rewarded from Your First Blacksmithing Work Order and the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package.

Tswen-luo Sageflower is the father of Yalia Sagewhisper and a prosperous fisherman and patriarch of the Sageflower family, who makes his home in Zouchin Village within the Kun-Lai Summit. In Yalia's youth, he owned his own boat. Due to his status, it was understood that his young daughter Yalia would be married off to the son of another successful fisherman. However, passing wisdom beyond her years Yalia saw that the competition between Chinwa and Yenki wouldn't end even after her hand had been won. Fearing that the two would compete until one was dead and the other left in guilt, Yalia made the difficult decision to leave Zouchin Village as a Guided Cub and became a member of the Shado-Pan.

True Iron Trigger is crafted with Engineering (1); taught by Schematic: True Iron Trigger

Truthguard is one of the artifacts used by protection paladins in World of Warcraft: Legion. Equipping it will automatically place Oathseeker in your main hand. Its hidden trait, The Light Reveals, can show certain NPCs as being demons in disguise.
Troy Baker is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Tunnel of Woe is found in the Hall of Shadows. It leads to the outside, under Dalaran itself. At its the end is The Plank.
Trousers of Royal Vanity drops from Opera Hall: Beautiful Beast in the Return to Karazhan.
Truthguard's Light is a Protection paladin artifact trait. It is linked to the Eye of Tyr (paladin artifact trait), Faith's Armor (artifact trait) and Scatter the Shadows traits.
Tryks Pourtrue is a goblin located in Boucher's Cauldron in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Trust in the Light is a Holy priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Holy Guidance, Focus in the Light and Serenity Now traits.
Tur'xoran is a satyr located at Shala'nir in Val'sharah. He is summoned with the Tur'xoran's Summoning Stone.
Tunnel Rat Lackey is a Tunnel Rat kobold located in Loch Modan. After Bluegill Representatives killed Mosshide Representative, the lackey escaped.

__NOTOC__ Tumultuous Water Spirits are water elementals located in .

Tsuo is a Rajani mogu warrior located on the Mogu'shan Terrace in Kun-Lai Summit, found mortally wounded by mantid invaders. With his dying breath, he asks Magni Bronzebeard and a champion of Azeroth to seek out his clan. The sigil he clutches in his hand proves the key to uncovering the return of the Rajani clan. In-game, he is referred to as the Mogu Warrior. His name is revealed by Stormspeaker Qian during Time-Lost Warriors.

The Tukulu Bridge is the bridge leading from Koramar to the Heart of Darkness.
Tsah'tal is a mogu located in the Five Sisters in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Tubbins Teapot Fire Mitts are a quest reward from My Terrible Morning.

Tu'u'gwar's Bait is provided as an objective for Meat on the Hook.

__NOTOC__ Troz'igal the Oppressor is a Maw caster located in the Adamant Vaults in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Trueborn Rainmakers are tarasek located at the Stormsunder Crater, Froststone Vault, and Lost Atheneum in the Forbidden Reach. Some ride Windscourge Drakes.

Trrsha is the pet beetle of Chief Grrlgllmesh, located in Mudfin Village in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

:There's a good reason a defensive strategy is called "turtling." Turtles are ancient creatures that have changed little over the eons. There are three main categories: sea turtles, land tortoises and fresh-water-dwelling terrapins. Turtles in World of Warcraft are similar in appearance, but much greater in size than their real-life counterparts. They can be found both on land, and in water. In Warcraft, turtles, sea turtles, and tortoises are often essentially the same, only differentiated by environment. The tortollans are a race of humanoid turtles.

The Tushui Pandaren, often shortened simply to the Tushui, are a group of Alliance pandaren led by Master Aysa Cloudsinger that adhere to the path of the Tushui, one of the two primary philosophies among the pandaren of the Wandering Isle. Tushui teachings encourage living a venerable life through meditation, rigorous training, and moral conviction. When the Wandering Isle was opened to the rest of the world, pandaren who upheld the tenets of Tushui were drawn to the Alliance due to their similar philosophies. The Tusks of Mannoroth were the tusks of the Pit Lord Mannoroth. After Grom Hellscream slew Mannoroth and freed the orcish horde from demonic enslavement once and for all, Warchief Thrall placed the skull on a large memorial in Orgrimmar with a plaque commemorating Grom's sacrifice. Years later, Grom's son Garrosh Hellscream would take the skull and cut it into two items: the larger part would decorate Garrosh's throne in Grommash Hold, while the tips would serve as his shoulder plates.
